name: local-handouts-manager-tests
description: JS test tooling for the Local Handouts Manager viewer: visual regression + performance profiling. The Flask app itself has no Node dependency; this is dev-only.

scripts.test:visual: npm run fixtures:visual && playwright test --config playwright.config.mjs
